scope: Read schema and opaque paths only. Do not open or inspect populated fixture files, source-ID tables or work cells. Existing frozen oracle bytes are unchanged.

wire_conventions.integers: JSON unsigned integer number tokens, NOT decimal strings. This finite oracle has no integer represented by a string. Deserialize u128 fields losslessly (serde_json Value::as_u64 only where source type/range is already established; otherwise typed u128). Do not cast semantic UInts through signed or floating-point values.
wire_conventions.null: JSON null is actual absent Option/control, not a string.
wire_conventions.variants: Externally tagged object with exactly one variant key, except unit Outcome Pending is a JSON string.
wire_conventions.arrays: Order significant except object-member order; compare serde_json::Value structural equality.
wire_conventions.objects: Key names/case significant. Descriptive prose is metadata, not product output to fabricate.
wire_conventions.expressions: Complete structural AST content; no serialized pointer, physical ExprId or generated provenance substitution.
wire_conventions.environment: Array of {name:string,value:Value}, ordered by lexical exact name. This is the A visible finite map, not the full shadowed B chain. Retain raw B ordered chains separately.
wire_conventions.frame_order: frames_top_first is the A order. B ordered raw frame spans remain distinct.
wire_conventions.records: Each record references adjacent complete snapshots by before_snapshot/after_snapshot array indices. No compressed state delta or missing snapshot fields.

types.TypeName: string enum matching public reference Type variant name

Outcome.Pending: unit variant encoded directly as JSON string Pending

types.PrefixWork: unsigned JSON integer array aligned to snapshots; source A charges, never raw B work
types.BinaryOpName: string enum matching public reference BinaryOp variant name

not_exercised_wire_variants: Only forms actually present in the frozen positive fixtures are specified above. Other public A variants (including Let/Unary expression+frame forms, Pattern Var, Error/rejection/exhaustion) remain obligations of the full projection implementation; no expected cells for them are supplied by these files and no complete nine-frame coverage claim follows.

pending_fixture_root_shape.B_event_ordinal_or_helper_phase_alignmen: descriptive scope qualification string; not runtime data

consumer_comparison_contract: Use only literal include paths to the opaque primary JSON files; do not inspect expected cells during source authoring.

Serialize actual projected A snapshots with the exact Snapshot/Program/Expr/Control/Frame/Value environment schema above, then compare each complete semantic snapshot and the complete ordered Record/prefix-work arrays to independently frozen fixtures.

Record before/after indices correspond to the complete actual snapshot vector. A consumer may instead compare actual A StepRecords directly to adjacent frozen snapshots, without generating a second expected trace.
Actual B raw spans, pending helpers, logical boundaries, source associations and B counters are retained separately and never synthesized from expected fixture indices or A charges.
Check the entire projected prefix through actual terminal publication; three terminal values alone do not satisfy this schema contract.
Scope decisions remain explicit: A visible maps do not erase raw B shadow cells; no full-B microstate/work expectation is created by this safe schema.
